arxiv-2108-06132.title: Kink propagation in the Artificial Axon
arxiv-2108-06132.creator: Xinyi Qi, Giovanni Zocchi
arxiv-2108-06132.description: Abstract The Artificial Axon is a unique synthetic system, based on biomolecular components, which supports action potentials. Here we consider, theoretically, the corresponding space extended system, and discuss the occurrence of solitary waves, or kinks. In contrast to action potentials, stationary kinks are possible.

arxiv-2111-12478.title: Predictive Data Race Detection for GPUs Conference: ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Programming Language Design and Implementation; June 20–24, 2022; San Diego, CA, USA
arxiv-2111-12478.creator: Sagnik Dey, Mayant Mukul, Parth Sharma, Swarnendu Biswas
arxiv-2111-12478.description: Abstract . The high degree of parallelism and relatively complicated synchronization mechanisms in GPUs make writing correct kernels difficult. Data races pose one such concurrency correctness challenge, and therefore, effective methods of detecting as many data races as possible are required.

arxiv-2111-15206.title: Amenability of quadratic automaton groups
arxiv-2111-15206.creator: Gideon Amir, Omer Angel, Balint Virág
arxiv-2111-15206.description: Abstract We give lower bounds for the electrical resistance between vertices in the Schreier graphs of the action of the linear (degree 1) and quadratic (degree 2) mother groups on the orbit of the zero ray. These bounds, combined with results of [ 10 ] show that every quadratic activity automaton group is amenable.

arxiv-2308-03681.title: Analytic density of states of tight-binding model for two-dimensional Chern insulator
arxiv-2308-03681.creator: Vera Uzunova, Krzysztof Byczuk
arxiv-2308-03681.description: Abstract We present analytic expressions for the density of states and its consistent derivation for the two-dimensional Qi-Wu-Zhang (QWZ) Hamiltonian, a generic model for the Chern topological insulators of class A. This density of states is expressed in terms of elliptical integrals. We discuss and plot special cases of the dispersion relations and the corresponding densities of states.

arxiv-2511-01126.title: Stochastic Regret Guarantees for Online Zeroth- and First-Order Bilevel Optimization
arxiv-2511-01126.creator: Parvin Nazari, Bojian Hou, Davoud Ataee Tarzanagh, Li Shen, George Michailidis, Los Angeles
arxiv-2511-01126.description: Abstract Online bilevel optimization (OBO) is a powerful framework for machine learning problems where both outer and inner objectives evolve over time, requiring dynamic updates. Current OBO approaches rely on deterministic window-smoothed regret minimization, which may not accurately reflect system performance when functions change rapidly.

pmc-11459095.title: Metagenomic insights into traditional fermentation of rice-based beverages among ethnic tribes in southern Assam, Northeast India
pmc-11459095.creator: Hanna Yumnam, Parijat Hazarika, Indu Sharma
pmc-11459095.description: IntroductionTraditional fermented foods have long been recognized for their numerous health benefits along with their potential to aid in the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders. pmc-11603564.title: Adipose tissue harvesting for microfragmented adipose tissue injection: A pilot study to evaluate safety and learning curve for orthopedic surgeons
pmc-11603564.creator: BB Varone, CBG Leite, PN Giglio, BS Kubota, RG Gobbi, MK Demange
pmc-11603564.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectivesThe objective of this study is to compare the complication rate between plastic and orthopedics surgeons on harvesting adipose tissue for osteoarthritic knee mFAT injections.MethodsWe evaluated patients with knee osteoarthritis who were submitted to a one-stage procedure that included the harvesting of abdominal adipose fat tissue, the processing of the adipose tissue using a single-use device Lipogems®, and the injection of the processed micro fragmented adipose tissue (mFAT) into the knee.

pmc-12312733.title: Hsa_circ_0002346 inhibits proliferation, invasion, and migration of breast cancer cells and promotes apoptosis: A novel potential biomarker for breast cancer
pmc-12312733.creator: Yixin Zhou, Linyi Wang, Wangjin Xu, Jiaxiang An, Guoming Hu, Feilin Cao, Liming Huang
pmc-12312733.description: BackgroundCircular RNA hsa_circ_0002346 has been implicated in the progression of various tumors, yet the functional role in breast cancer remains poorly understood. This study aimed to investigate the significance of hsa_circ_0002346 in breast cancer (BC).MethodsQuantitative reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction assays were performed to detect hsa_circ_0002346 expression in BC cell lins and 27 patients with BC.

pmc-12398010.title: Long COVID-19: a Four-Year prospective cohort study of risk factors, recovery, and quality of life
pmc-12398010.creator: Sanaa M Kamal, Mohammed S Al Qahtani, Ali Al Aseeri, Mohey El Deen Mohamed Naghib, Adul Majeed Mazroua Al Mazroua, Abdulaziz M M Alshamrani, Mohamed Mazroua Al Mazroua, Faisal S F AlHarbi
pmc-12398010.description: PurposeLong COVID-19 is a growing public health concern, but its long-term burden and predictors remain underexplored, particularly in underrepresented populations.MethodsThis four-year prospective cohort study was conducted in Saudi Arabia, enrolling adults with confirmed acute COVID-19 from multiple affiliated healthcare centers between March 2020 and March 2024.

pmc-12559190.title: Study on urban passenger transport carbon reduction pathways based on system dynamics
pmc-12559190.creator: Ranqi Liu, Ning Liu
pmc-12559190.description: Passenger transport carbon emission control is recognized as a critical component in achieving the dual-carbon goals amid accelerating urbanization. A system dynamics model incorporating population and economic factors, energy consumption, traffic operation, and carbon emission control has been developed. Through boundary identification and validation of variable relationships, a simulation model has been established.

pmc-12605635.title: Harnessing GSK-3β inhibition for lung cancer therapy: emerging opportunities and challenges
pmc-12605635.creator: Emad H. M. Hassanein, Hanan S. Althagafy, Hanan H. Abd- ElHafeez, Islam M. Ibrahim, Badrah S. Alghamdi
pmc-12605635.description: Lung cancer (LC) primarily affects men and is the third most common cause of cancer-related death worldwide. Treatment for LC involves many phases, each with specific challenges arising from the characteristics of malignancy and the limitations of chemotherapy. GSK-3β, a serine/threonine kinase factor, is essential for several signals that control important cellular functions and a variety of diseases, including cancer.

pmc-12615775.title: Educational quality of YouTube videos on video assisted thoracoscopic segmentectomy
pmc-12615775.creator: Nilay Çavuşoğlu Yalçın, Ayşegül Güler, Muharrem Özkaya
pmc-12615775.description: Video-assisted thoracoscopic segmentectomy (VATS) is increasingly performed as a parenchyma-sparing procedure for early-stage lung cancer, yet standardized educational resources remain limited. YouTube is widely accessed by surgeons and trainees, but the educational quality of its content is largely unregulated. This study systematically evaluated YouTube videos on VATS segmentectomy using the validated LAParoscopic surgery Video Educational GuidelineS (LAP-VEGaS) tool.
